content: Alibaba Cloud has two SDK generations: V1.0 aliyun-python-sdk-core-v3 (AcsClient + CommonRequest, action-based, entering Basic-Security-Maintenance-only per Alibaba's own repo notice) and V2.0 modular per-service packages (alibabacloud_python-sdk on GitHub, officially recommended). For CSPM posture checks, relevant V2 packages: alibabacloud_config20200907 (Cloud Config service — GetComplianceSummary/ListConfigRules/ListDiscoveredResources, resource compliance state) and alibabacloud_sas20181203 (Security Center/Threat Detection — DescribeCheckWarningSummary/DescribeSecurityCheckSchedule, baseline check pass/fail). Both require peer deps alibabacloud_tea_openapi and alibabacloud_credentials. Backend already depends on the V1 aliyun-python-sdk-core-v3 (>=2.13.33, already latest) via backend/alibaba_ingest.py (AK/SK/region auth, mocked, targets security_events not cloud_findings) — V2 packages are not yet in requirements.txt.
